epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the discrepancy rate between internal task state and GitHub PR state to 0%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Project progress stalling due to misalignment
requirements: R1: Patch internal synchronization logic to correctly update task state based on actual GitHub PR status

slices.title: Patch PR state synchronization logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the state reconciliation for this epic, I want to patch the internal sync loop, so that stale 'done' states are overwritten by accurate GitHub realities
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task marked 'done' internally but not merged on GitHub
When the synchronization patch executes and is verified by tests
Then the internal status is reverted to reflect the GitHub PR state
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unhandled state sync mismatches to 0%
